rendering: Qt offscreen native widgets; simulation only

monitor_fault_visibility.error_text_initial: Error: Synthetic acquisition failure for audit

findings.finding: Worker status and GUI run state are disconnected; an initialization failure leaves Running and a Stop action that does not recover the UI.
findings.recommendation: Use one authoritative run lifecycle for start, stop, completion, fault, and backend status.

findings.finding: Apply mutates shared settings while the controller and viewer retain some old values; the viewer sample rate stays at its construction value.
findings.recommendation: Separate editable draft from the validated configuration captured for a run; lock acquisition and mode changes during a run.

findings.finding: Individual widget ranges permit combinations that fail at initialization or disagree with effective control bounds.
findings.recommendation: Validate Nyquist, block/PSD sizing, buffer sizing, level bounds, and units as a complete configuration; show errors beside fields before enabling Start.

findings.finding: Apply and backend selection are below the fold; seven groups include inactive settings and the run controls exist only on the Controller tab.
findings.recommendation: Keep backend, state, target summary, Start/Stop, and change status in the main window; reveal setup and advanced parameters when needed.

findings.finding: Sine displays reuse the random PSD/EQ layout, retain the previous target, and keep histories across runs; EQ refresh accumulates legend entries.
findings.recommendation: Reset each run and mode explicitly; show the mode-specific primary plot and use separate unchanged/clear/update semantics for plot updates.

findings.finding: The metrics graph mixes g, dimensionless level, percent saturation, and g/V on one axis; labels and colors differ between the controller and data views.
findings.recommendation: Use unit-specific numeric readouts and separate selected trends in elapsed seconds; keep measured/target colors and line styles consistent.

findings.finding: The monitor accepts a 10-second PSD window with a 2-second buffer and overwrites fault text with Stopped.
findings.recommendation: Match retained samples to the requested analysis window or report the effective window; retain faults until dismissed or a new run starts.

findings.finding: Targets, channels, calibration provenance, and log output paths are largely file-based; there is no visible review of the exact setup used for a completed run.
findings.recommendation: Add editable target/channel setup, calibration source, effective settings, and a results view with log locations and summaries.

limits: Native Qt widgets were captured with the offscreen platform; macOS chrome, keyboard/screen-reader usability, and physical DAQ behavior were not validated.
Simulation packets were supplied through the existing worker and UI methods; this is a workflow audit, not a sustained performance or hardware tracking test.
No production application code was changed; artifacts are local and uncommitted.

proposal_checks.browser: Chrome, localhost preview through the visualization renderer
verified_interactions: Invalid sample rate blocks Start and shows field feedback
Sine mode uses g-peak and its own plot
Monitor mode hides level and recording controls
Guided setup validation, start, stop, and review
proposal_checks.limits: Illustrative prototype only; no hardware, export, keyboard/screen-reader, or full end-to-end native GUI validation.
